mapper.select:
SELECT b.id, c.category_name AS categoryName, b.title, b.views, , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file f WHERE f.board_id = b.id AND f.state = false) AS fileCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment co WHERE co.board_id = b.id) AS commentCount, m.member_name AS author FROM ( SELECT b2.id FROM board b2
JOIN category c2 ON c2.id = b2.category_id
JOIN member m2 ON m2.id = b2.member_id
ORDER BY
b2.title b2.views c2.category_name b2.id
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{search.limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) t JOIN board b ON b.id = t.id JOIN category c ON c.id = b.category_id JOIN member m ON m.id = b.member_id ORDER BY
b.title b.views c.category_name b.id
ASC DESC

SELECT b.id, c.category_name, b.title, , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file f WHERE f.board_id = b.id AND f.state = false) AS fileCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment co WHERE co.board_id = b.id) AS commentCount FROM board b JOIN category c ON c.id = b.category_id WHERE b.board_type_id = #{boardTypeId} AND b.state = false ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT 5
